newsitem.title: USA: Huntway Partners LP files for Chap 11 bankruptcy.
newsitem.headline: Huntway Partners LP files for Chap 11 bankruptcy.

text.p: Huntway Partners LP filed for Chapter 11 protection in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Delaware on Tuesday.

In court papers, the company listed assets with a book value of $80.4 million and liabilities of $109.2 million, including $26.4 million in senior secured notes and $56.0 million in senior subordinated notes. Huntway, of Newhall, California, produces liquid asphalt and refined petroleum products from crude oil.
Huntway Managing Partners controls at least 20 percent of the company's voting stock and Huntway LP in turn is the controlling general partner of Sunbelt Refining Co LP.
